elements.text: Food & Agricultural Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) — 1945
World Health Organisation (WHO) — 1948 — directs and coordinates international health within the UN system
Codex Alimentarius Commission (1963) — FAO and WHO combined to run this commission which has established a food code and international standards that ensure food is safe and can be traded
World Trade Organisation (WTO) — 1995 — established with the main aim of negotiating agreements to reduce obstacles to international trade
